english.title: Fail to notify registrar of someone not becoming a person with significant control on incorporation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) who was in default,]_

to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied, and which knew that a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), named in the statement under section 12A(1)(a) as a person who would, on the company's incorporation, become a registrable person or a registrable relevant legal entity did not so become, and without reasonable excuse failed to give notice to the registrar of companies for England and Wales in accordance with section 790LG of the Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 790LG and 790LJ of the Companies Act 2006.
